newsitem.title: USA: White House sets 1430 EDT Mideast statement.
newsitem.headline: White House sets 1430 EDT Mideast statement.

text.p: The White House on Wednesday scheduled a "summarizing" statement by President Bill Clinton on the Middle East peace talks at 1430 EDT/1830 GMT.

A White House spokeswoman said Clinton would speak alone. Palestinian President Yasser Arafat and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, while both expected to attend Clinton's appearance, were not expected to make statements, she added.

The statement "will talk about what the nature of the discussions have been over the past few days and where we move from here," a senior White House official said. There was no indication any breakthrough had been achieved.
The White House said that Clinton was to speak in the East Room of the White House. His appearance had earlier been tentatively scheduled for 1400 EDT (1800 GMT).
Clinton was to speak after playing host at a working lunch for Arafat, Netanyahu and Jordan's King Hussein.
Earlier, White House spokesman Mike McCurry declined to characterise the status of the talks, triggered by gun battles that have killed 58 Palestinians and 15 Israelis in the past week.
